pilot.note: Earlier Mipo approach; not part of randomized B repetitions.

B4-r1-invalid.reason: Guidance was not active; the setup screenshot still showed a 400km route selection screen. Trial input had already been queued; all results of this attempt are excluded. Repeat B4-r1-retry preserves randomized condition order.

deviations: Overpass main endpoint returned HTTP 406 for POST and GET; alternative endpoint timed out after 45s; OSM map API succeeded.
One script invocation had an incorrect relative output path and exited before launching DHU; corrected.
Computer-use plugin did not list DHU and rejected its executable path as an app; used documented DHU console tap and screenshot.
Mora route preview initially used phone position and showed 382km; after starting guidance and resending approach fix, Naver rerouted to 4.3km via tunnel. Excluded initial route preview from trial.
B4-r1 preparation remained on route selection; its trial input was inadvertently queued and is excluded. B4-r1-retry is the valid repetition.

While canceling queued setup, a request file already being processed was removed. Controller exited on FileNotFoundError after unused B2-r1 setup; DHU exited. Added an existence check and restarted controller. No valid trial was active during controller failure.
Android package UID lookup returned the primary-profile UID and a permission error for user 150; no attempt was made to access that other profile.
B4-r1-retry first preparation had no active guidance; trial was withheld until manual recent-destination selection and fresh position injection produced verified 2.4km guidance.
One host temporary-log inventory glob matched no file; the ADB server open-file list was used to locate its log.

tunnel_geometry.geometry_limit: OSM represents this tunnel by two endpoints; interpolated straight segment

road_geometry.path_method: Directed shortest path through motor roads from shared start node to a node near Mipo; screen guidance checked before each run. First 420m of path used.

limits: TLS payload not decoded; NAN omission versus NaN and sensor timestamp representation unresolved.
Screen distance is rounded to 0.1km; approximate distance/rate only.
C4 later motion cannot distinguish fresh-coordinate following from extrapolation at last accepted 5m/s.
Tunnel exit was not reached. Actual car, dongle and real vehicle timestamps untested.
Each A value and each C condition was tested once; B repetition counts follow the protocol.
Optional A accuracy ramp not run; C4 is a separate ramp in a mapped tunnel.
A/B share this experiment road; its first section differs from experiment2 Dongbaek-ro approach.

cleanup.retained: outputs/ user-facing reports and evidence; pre-existing Java/Python runtimes untouched

timing_semantics: Command timestamps are host console dispatch times, not sensor-message timestamps. Screenshot labels are scheduled elapsed seconds; actual timing is in commands-timed.jsonl.
